{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Confirm the example values
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())"}
